question: Average salary per department, with the department name
gold: SELECT d.name, ROUND(AVG(e.salary)::numeric, 2) FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.name

question: Which department has the highest total salary spend?
gold: SELECT d.name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY SUM(e.salary) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders have each status?
gold: SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: Total revenue (quantity times unit price) from delivered orders
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)::numeric, 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

question: Top 5 customers by total amount spent (name and total)
gold: SELECT c.full_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

question: Names of products that have never been ordered
gold: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_item_id IS NULL

question: Employees who earn more than their manager (names only)
gold: SELECT e.full_name FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON m.employee_id = e.manager_id WHERE e.salary > m.salary

question: Number of customers per country
gold: SELECT country, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country

question: Most expensive product in each category (category and product name)
gold: SELECT DISTINCT ON (category) category, name FROM products ORDER BY category, unit_price DESC
